content: Qa7aata Kochaas Imetida Ooso
Goday Musenne Aarona haysada yaagis;
“Leewe kochatape Qahaata kochatanne enta soo asaa asaa shaakada tayba.
Laythi 30-50 gakida adde ubbaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan oothanaw danda7eyisata tayba.
Qahaata kochati Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan oothana oosoy Dunkaaniyan go7etiya geeshsha miisheta aawatethan naago.
“Asay gutaape baanaw dendiya wode Aaroninne iya adde nayti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelidi, Caaqo Taabotiya sinthan de7iya magarajuwa wodhisidi he Caaqo Taabotiya iyara xaaxo.
He kamaa bolla liiqo galba kammo; iya bolla gujidi kaalose carqe kammo; tookiya kasota sagaayotan aatho.
“Godaas shiiqiya uytha wothiya xarpheezaa bolla kaalose carqe kammo. Xarpheeza bolla saaneta, cilpata, xuu7atanne woyne ushsha yarshuwa duuqiya otota wothona. Uythay ubba wode xarpheeza bolla de7o.
He ubbaa bolla zo7o carqe kammidi iya bolla qassi liiqo galba kammo; hessafe kaallidi tookiya kasota sagaayotan aatho.
“Kaalose carqe ekidi xompe wothiya kocaa, iya xompetara, iya qaphetara, bido kessiya keretaranne zayte tigiya xaarotara ubbaa kammo.
Yaatidi iya miisheta ubbaa liiqo galban kammidi tookiya arsa bolla wothona.
“Kaallidi worqa yarsho saaxiniya kaalose carqen kammo; qassi iya bollara liiqo galba yeggo. Yaatidi tookiya kasota sagaayotan aatho.
Hessadaka, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon go7etiya miisheta ubbaa kaalose carqen xaaxo; iya bolla liiqo galba yeggidi, tookiya alga bolla wotho.
“Naase yarsho bessaafe biduwa pitidi iya bolla ocha teera daaniya carqe kammo.
Yarsho bessan go7etiya miisheta ubbaa; tama cooceta, asho qapheta, akaafatanne haatha kereta iya bolla wothidi, liiqo galba kammo. Yaatidi tookiya kasota sagaayotan aatho.

Aaroninne iya adde nayti, geeshshabatanne iyan go7etiya geeshsha miisheta ubbaa kammidaape guye Isra7eele asay gutaape dendiya wode Qahaata kochay yidi tooko. Shin enti hayqonna mela geeshsha miisheta bochofo. Geeshsha Dunkaaney bessaafe dendiya wode qahaata kochaas de7iya aawatethay haysa.

“Kahiniya Aarona na7ay Alaazari xompe zaytiya, sawiya ixaaniya, yarsho kathaanne tiyo zaytiya, hessadaka Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan de7iya dumma dumma geeshsha miisheta ubbaa bolla aawatethi de7ees” yaagis.
Goday Musekonne Aaronako,
“Qahaata kochay Leewe kochaa giddofe hayqidi dhayana mela oothopite.
Ubbaafe Geeshsha miishiyako shiiqidi hayqonna mela Aaroninne iya adde nayti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddo gelidi, Qohaata kochay huuphen huuphen oothana oosuwanne tookana toohuwa shaakidi besso.
Qahaata kochay hayqonnaada geeshsha miisheta be7anaw guutha wodeska Dunkaaniya giddo gelopo” yaagis.
Gedisoona Kochaas Imetida Ooso
Goday Museko,
“Leewe kochaafe Gedisoona kochaanne enta soo asaa asaa shaakada tayba.
Laythi 30-50 gakida adde ubbaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanaw danda7eyisata tayba.
Gedisoona kochati oothana oosoy haysafe kaallidi de7eysa;
enti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya gaatha kamaa, kare kamaa, bollara yegetiya liiqo do7a galba, geliya wula bolla kaqetiya magarajuwa tooko.

Hessadaka Geeshsha Dunkaaniyanne yarsho bessa yuushuwan de7iya dabaaba magarajota, dabaaba geliya wula bolla de7iya gesheta, wodorotanne iyaw go7etiya miisheta ubbaa tooko. Gedisoona kochay miishetan oothanaw bessiya ooso ubbaa ootho.
Tooho gidin, hara ooso gidin, enti oothiya ooso ubbaa Aaroninne iya adde nayti enta kaalli oosiso. Enti tookanaw bessiyabata ubbaa ne aawatethan entaw gisha.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon Gedisoona kochay oothana oosoy haysa. Enta oosuwa kahiniya Aarona na7ay Itamaari kaallidi oosiso.
Maraara Kochaas Imetida Ooso
“Leewe kochaafe Meraara kochaanne enta soo asaa asaa shaakada tayba.
Laythi 30-50 gakida adde ubbaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanaw danda7eyisata tayba.
“Enti Dunkaaniya tuuqeta, liyoota, tuussata, Dunkaaniya gedata,
Dunkaaniya yuushon dabaaban eqiya tuussata, he tuussata gedata, dhisheta, wodorotanne iyan koshshiya miisheta ubbaa tooko. Issoy issoy tookanaw bessiya miishiya iya sunthan shaakada gisha.
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon Meraara kochay oothana oosoy haysa. Enti oothana ooso ubbaa kahiniya Aarona na7aa Itamaari aawatethan kaallidi oosiso” yaagis.
Leewe Kocha Taybuwa
Musey, Aaroninne Isra7eele halaqati Qahaata kocha enta soo asan asan shaakidi taybidosona.
Laythi 30-50 gakida adde ubbaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanaw danda7eyisata taybidosona.
Enta tayboy 2,750.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothana mela Museynne Aaroni taybida Qahaata kochati haysata.
Gedisoona kochati banta soo asan asan shaaketidi taybetidosona.
Laythi 30-50 gakida addeti ubbaa Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanaw danda7eyisata
tayboy 2,630.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothana mela Museynne Aaroni taybida Gedisoona kochati haysata.
Meraara kochati banta soo asan asan shaaketidi taybetidosona.
Laythi 30-50 gakida addeti ubbay, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanaw danda7eyisata
tayboy 3,200.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothana mela Museynne Aaroni taybida Meraara kochati haysata.
Musey, Aaroninne Isra7eele halaqati Leeweta ubbaa enta kochaaninne enta soo asan asan shaakidi tayba.
Laythi 30-50 gakida addeti ubbay, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon oothanawnune miisheta tookanaw danda7iya,
Leeweta tayboy 8,580.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, enti huuphen huuphen taybetidosona. Hessadaka Goday Muse kiitidaysada enti oothana oosoynne tookana toohoy imetis.
